summary: Iteration 20 — PokeCoins commercial launch reconfiguration (hybrid SellAuth) fully verified. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_pokecoins_launch_v20.py with 20 test cases across 7 review areas: (1) GET /api/categories returns exactly ['pokecoin_bundle','hunting_service','event_pass','pokelid','medals','stardust'] in that order, no shundo_service; (2) both Shundo products moved to hunting_service and still coming_soon; Auto Raid Hunting (SA 870739, /images/autoraid.jpeg, 25/50/75/100 Raids @ 24.99/44.99/62.99/79.99), Egg Hatching (SA 870828, /images/Eggs.jpeg, 9/27/54 Eggs @ 29.99/74.99/129.99), Shiny Shadow (SA 870940, /images/shinyshadow.jpeg, 7 variants 1614148-1614154 all $100, coming_soon=True); (3) POST /api/products with dup name returns 409 with 'already exists' detail, new name returns 200, unique index on products.name confirmed via direct Mongo index_information() query; (4) PUT /api/products/{id} description edit persists and GET /api/products echoes; (5) GET /api/admin/sync/catalog dry-run against production returned 200 with 14 creates + 5 updates — Shundo/GO Pass Deluxe correctly appear as UPDATES (matched by sellauth_product_id) not CREATES; GO Pass Deluxe update carries a 'variants' diff with from/to shapes; (6) catalog_sync.target_base(own_host) unit-tested: raises SyncError when host matches (case-insensitive, ignores port), raises when PUBLIC_APP_URL is not https, accepts distinct hosts; request_host() correctly reads X-Forwarded-Host; end-to-end HTTP spoof is impossible because K8s ingress rewrites the header, but the guard wiring is proven at unit level; (7) coupon regression: 10% percent-coupon /api/coupons/validate excludes Event Pass by name in excluded_names, eligible_subtotal < subtotal; pass-only cart returns 400 with 'Event Passes' message; sellauth_cart() attaches custom_price only to discounted lines and sellauth._cart_line() renders discounted lines as name/price/quantity (custom) while catalog lines use productId/variantId. Frontend Playwright verified end-to-end: /products Hunting Service tab lists all 5 products with correct images (autoraid.jpeg, Eggs.jpeg + 2 Shundo + shinyshadow.jpeg), variant selectors on Auto Raid (4 opts) and Egg Hatching (3 opts), Shiny Shadow shows Coming Soon overlay and JOIN WAITLIST button, no add-to-cart. Admin > Products lists all 3 new hunting rows with correct SA ids and option counts (Auto Raid · 4 OPTIONS, Egg Hatching · 3 OPTIONS, Shiny Shadow · 7 OPTIONS · SOON). Edit-description dialog saves via save-product-btn and the change round-trips through GET /api/products (rollback done). ADD PRODUCT with duplicate name 'Auto Raid Hunting' surfaces sonner toast 'A product named “Auto Raid Hunting” already exists' after the backend returns 409. All 20 backend tests pass, all frontend flows green.
critical_code_review_comments: Live sync dry-run reports a MASSIVE variant-price mismatch for GO Pass Deluxe: Mega Finale variant '+ 10 Ranks' (sellauth_variant_id 1570360): target=$14.99 but source (preview)=$114.99. If an admin clicks PUSH TO PRODUCTION this will 8x the price on the live storefront. Either (a) the preview SellAuth fetch returned a stale/wrong value and the DB was cached, or (b) production's price is stale. Recommend re-running seed_variants (which re-fetches from SellAuth) on preview before allowing a push, and adding a sanity guard in catalog_sync that flags any variant price change > 200%. Copy-paste from the dry-run response: "+ 10 Ranks","price":114.99 (source) vs "+10 Ranks","price":14.99 (target).

server.py has grown to 1836 lines. The catalog-sync block (_sync_catalog, request_host, endpoints) plus SEED_VARIANTS/EXTRA_PRODUCTS/migrate_hunting_category/seed_variants is ~250 lines and would move out to /app/backend/seed.py cleanly. Same refactor previously flagged for the review block.

Products.jsx line 33: hero copy still reads '…and elite Shundo hunting' but Shundo is now merged into the wider 'Hunting Service' category. Consider updating the marketing tagline to something like '…and elite hunting services'.

ProductCard.jsx line 15: locked=(category==='event_pass' && (!hasOther || passCount>=1)). If hasOther is false AND passCount is already >=1 it still shows 'Locked' which is correct, but the tooltip 'Add another product first — one pass per order' does not distinguish the 'already at limit' case from the 'need a base product' case. Minor UX polish.

catalog_sync._payload strips None values but not empty strings, so a badge change from 'COMING SOON' to '' will be sent as an update — good, that is intended, but note the dry-run diff for Shundo shows badge: {from:'COMING SOON', to:''} because the seeded EXTRA_PRODUCTS do not set a badge. Confirm that removing the COMING SOON badge on push is the desired behavior; if not, seed the coming-soon products with badge='COMING SOON'.

sellauth_cart() puts custom_price on every OrderItem whose line_key is in unit_prices, which currently reflects the discounted lines only. Correct today, but the invariant is not asserted anywhere — an accidental change to compute_discount that leaks the eligible-line prices for pass items would silently discount Event Passes at SellAuth. Consider an assertion inside sellauth_cart that no NO_DISCOUNT category ever carries a custom_price.
